summary: The official survey is mostly positive, but review sites and forums are mostly negative, and both keep coming back to behaviour and bullying. 43% of pupils speak English as an additional language; nothing found from international families in particular.
reviews: Snobe: 1.9/5 from 10 reviews (Dec 2024–May 2026). Reviewers describe rude pupils, bullying, a "chaotic" atmosphere and inconsistent discipline; some praise kind teachers and a helpful Head of Year.
forums: Mumsnet, two short threads (2021, 2025): the school "never had a great reputation", but the management is seen as improving it. Mostly second-hand; no first-hand accounts of SEND support. Good Schools Guide page not readable.
ask: How bullying is reported and followed up; how SEND support works day to day; how consistently the behaviour policy is applied.
